column2: Recap question holds to cue end, title swaps to "One to take with you" by f109540, cube with rod on "Here is a solid cube". Rod hidden inside the cube and visible above and below. Clean.

the rod: our axis on sentence 2. Long still stretch, 7 s, under the description of the rod. Spin starts at sentence 3 with circles at both ends and grey key "each corner keeps to a circle about the rod". Front edge moves right: counterclockwise seen from above.

Blue then purple faces at about 270° and 290°, home at f110753: one full lap. Rod x constant. Follow-one-corner set up on sentence 4: small ring with dot on the start corner, big ring on the target corner, spin ½ lap, time 0.00, laps 0.00. Grey "time" and "laps so far" dim, see P6.

time 0.97 laps 0.48, then 1.00 and 0.50: laps = time × ½ holds. Dot lands in the big ring. Gold arc along the far half of the circle. Faces purple and teal: half turn of the four coloured sides. "every corner halfway round: a half turn about the rod" on sentence 5. Small bump at the lower right corner of the cube, see P9.
Hold through 12_5 start. "Here is the puzzle." over a static stage. Clean.
How many steady spins end at this half turn after one unit of time? on sentence 2. Readable by its last word: full two lines at f111760, spoken question ends about f112126.
Hints arrive in order: "the laps", "the direction of spin", "the axis", all by cue end f112347 (1872.45 s). Nothing gives the count. Gold bar on the predict mark f112396, width 229 of tile.
Bar 218, 207, 201, 150 at f112408, f112419, f112426, f112479: about 57 tile px per s, linear. Would reach zero near f112637. No answer on the card. No "pause for more time" text (P7).
